# Fish Audio

> Fish Audio is an AI-powered platform for text-to-speech, voice cloning, and audio generation with fine-grained control and multilingual support.

Fish Audio provides a comprehensive suite of AI voice and audio tools including the open-source S2 Pro engine with word-level prosody control, supporting 80+ languages. The platform serves content creators, developers, and teams with both web applications and API access.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-Speech (TTS)
- Voice Cloning
- Speech-to-Text (STT)
- AI Voice Generation
- S2 Pro Engine
- Multilingual Support
- Fine-Grained Voice Control
- Audio Separation
- Sound Effects Generation
- Voice Translation
- Open-Source
- API Access
- Content Creation
- Emotion Control
- Team Collaboration

## Core Products

- [Fish Audio Homepage](https://fish.audio): Fish Audio homepage: AI text-to-speech and voice cloning with emotion control
- [Text to Speech](https://fish.audio/tts): Fish Audio S2 Pro text-to-speech with emotional control and multilingual support
- [Voice Cloning](https://fish.audio/voice-clone): Fish Audio voice cloning with emotion transfer and multilingual dubbing
- [Speech-to-Text](https://fish.audio/stt): Fish Audio speech-to-text transcription with multilingual and real-time support
- [Audio Translation](https://fish.audio/translate-audio): Fish Audio translation preserving original voice with multilingual support
- [Sound Effects Generation](https://fish.audio/sound-effects): Fish Audio SFX generation from text for games, videos, and podcasts
- [Audio Separation](https://fish.audio/audio-separation): Fish Audio audio separation for vocal isolation and music stem extraction
